offering_description.value: Designs and markets premium performance running shoes, apparel and accessories under the On brand. Sells to running and lifestyle consumers and to retailers, through its own online store, own stores and wholesale partners. Products are made by contract manufacturers, mainly in Asia.

primary_products.value: running shoes; sportswear and apparel; accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: runners, athletes and lifestyle consumers buying footwear and apparel; B2B: specialty sporting goods retailers, department stores and distributors buying wholesale

end_markets.value: athletic footwear; sportswear and apparel; running and outdoor; lifestyle fashion

revenue_model.value: product sales: footwear and apparel sold direct to consumers online and in own stores; product sales: footwear and apparel sold wholesale to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets products made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific, with the US the largest market

specialization.value: related lines: running footwear, apparel and accessories sharing the same brand, customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: online: own e-commerce website direct to consumers; own locations: company-operated retail stores; third-party retail: specialty running stores, sporting goods chains and department stores; distributors / dealers: distributors in markets without direct presence
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; third-party retail; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal consumer product, import tariff, trade and labor-practice rules apply to footwear sourcing and sales
